name: LValueData.toPoly_eq_rename_harmonicPoly
summary: Both sides are the same intertwining map on Schur modules, checked on the Weyl evaluations (`ext_schur_weylEval`).

steps.claim: Two intertwining maps of the Schur module agree if they agree on the Weyl evaluations (`ext_schur_weylEval`); here both send the highest vector to the same polynomial (the mixed Cartan embedding intertwines, `rowSubst_highestPoly`, the letters `fockLetters`), so they agree on η.
steps.lean:
congr($(ext_schur_weylEval (rowPos _) (L' := (rename _).toLinearMap ∘ₗ _) fun g ↦ by
  have := (mixedCartan n X.auxPair.colsPlus 0).intertwines g
  simp_all [AuxPair.harmonicPoly, -mulVec_mulVec, MixedCartanEmbedding.top, letterPoly,
    weylKernel, ↓rowSubst_highestPoly, rowSubst, fockLetters, X.one_lt_card]) η)
